diff --git a/src/preprocessing/symptom_processor.py b/src/preprocessing/symptom_processor.py
index de01766..971e858 100644
--- a/src/preprocessing/symptom_processor.py
+++ b/src/preprocessing/symptom_processor.py
@@ -12,11 +12,12 @@ def normalize_symptom(symptom: str) -> str:
     # Lowercase
     symptom = symptom.lower().strip()
     
-    # Replace spaces and hyphens with underscores
-    symptom = re.sub(r'[\s\-]+', '_', symptom)
+    # Replace spaces, hyphens, and punctuation with underscores
+    # Note: \u0964 (।) and \u0965 (॥) are Devanagari danda and double danda punctuation marks
+    symptom = re.sub(r'[\s\-\u0964\u0965]+', '_', symptom)
     
-    # Remove special characters
-    symptom = re.sub(r'[^\w]', '', symptom)
+    # Remove special characters except alphanumeric, Devanagari characters, and underscore
+    symptom = re.sub(r'[^\w\u0900-\u097F]', '', symptom)
     
     return symptom
